work.name: Intelligent Machines Lab, Information Technology University
work.summary: Worked under the guidance of Dr. Waqas Sultani on Domain Generalization.
highlights: Investigated methods to improve DETR-based models' generalizability to unseen target domains.
Proposed incorporating Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) with model features, improving generalization from 34.1 to 38.7 mAP@50 on the Leukemia Attri dataset.
Converted findings into a comprehensive academic paper.

work.name: Intelligent Machines Lab, Information Technology University
work.summary: Collaborated with Dr. Waqas Sultani's research group on microscopy image analysis.
highlights: Helped develop an Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) framework for microscopy images with source-target domain transfer.
Proposed and integrated Monte Carlo Dropout (MCD) for uncertainty-aware pseudo-labeling and confidence image-mixing.
Assisted in writing, running experiments, and designing experiments.

work.name: Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences and Technology
work.summary: Worked under the guidance of Dr. Khurram Khan Jadoon on security applications.

Achieved competitive performance compared to industry benchmarks in security applications.

projects.name: DINOv1 Implementation for ResNet
projects.summary: Implemented DINOv1 training pipeline for ResNet models for self-supervised learning.
highlights: Enabled self-supervised feature learning without labels.
Developed a finetuning pipeline to adapt the pre-trained model for classification tasks.
Utilized clear coding practices for seamless CLI training.

projects.name: xv6-riscv Kernel Implementation
projects.summary: Extended the xv6 filesystem and kernel architecture.
highlights: Extended filesystem with doubly-indirect blocks, increasing max file size capacity by ≈245x (from 268 KB to 65.8 MB).
Implemented symbolic links with recursive path resolution and O_NOFOLLOW security flag.
Developed custom system calls to expose kernel physical memory allocator statistics.

projects.name: Vision Transformer (ViT) Implementation
projects.summary: Implemented Vision Transformer architecture from scratch in PyTorch.
highlights: Built multi-head self-attention mechanism, positional encoding, and patch embedding layers.
Implemented transformer encoder blocks with layer normalization and feed-forward networks.
Achieved 70.66% accuracy on PascalVOC2012 without pretraining or hyperparameter tuning.

projects.name: ResNet Implementation
projects.summary: Implemented ResNet architecture from scratch using PyTorch.
highlights: Built multiple ResNet variants (ResNet-50, 101, 152) with configurable depth and block types.
Trained and validated on image classification datasets to verify correctness.
Achieved 88.44% accuracy on CardDataset without hyperparameter tuning.
